_comment: Word loc -> Konsep library ids (belajar/pipeline/authored/library.concepts.json) that the word illustrates; feeds Word.concepts in schema.ts. Same format as al-fatihah.concepts-map.json. Records are status draft as pipeline state; there is no human review step (plan L11). Existing ids are from belajar/content/library.json; NEW ids (maqul-al-qaul and sighat-mubalaghah, shared with the Al-Ikhlas/Al-Falaq maps; athaf-bayan, rubai-mujarrad, hal) are described with their sources in an-nas.new-concepts.md. validate.py checks the map both ways against each concept's `examples`, so the integrator must add every loc below to the `examples` of each listed concept (suggested notes in an-nas.new-concepts.md). Ids are listed in library order, new ids last.
